description: Changes: overwrites one stay's nightly rates (or rate plan) for its nights not yet posted. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Changes a stay's nightly rate or rate plan for its nights not yet posted. Send nightly_rate (every night), nights (each night's rate), or rate_plan alone (priced by that plan). First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. Not for an Expedia stay. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to make the change shown in the preview

nightly_rate.description: Dollars a night, for every night of the stay
